headline: EPS improves on last quarter, slips on last year
summary_short: Seven & i's reported EPS was ¥28.05, up 7.0% q/q from ¥26.21 and down 2.8% y/y from ¥28.86.
summary_long: EPS of ¥28.05 compares with ¥26.21 in the prior quarter (+7.0%) and ¥28.86 a year earlier (-2.8%). No revenue, margin or cash figures are on the shard for this event.
